searches.answer: The latest research papers in AI and ML include "SimCLR" from February 2020, which introduced a simplified framework for contrastive learning, and "Idefics2" from April 2024, which improved OCR capabilities with a simplified architecture. From Morgan Stanley, notable papers include "Rethinking Langevin Thompson Sampling from A Stochastic Approximation Perspective" and "Average-Case Hardness of Parity Problems: Orthogonal Vectors, k-SUM and More." The "10 Noteworthy AI Research Papers of 2023" highlights techniques like DPO and QLoRA for simplified finetuning processes. The "10 Must Read Machine Learning Research Papers" includes the seminal "Attention Is All You Need" paper introducing the Transformer model. The sources don't provide a definitive answer to the latest research papers AI ML simplified beyond these specific examples.
